notes.title: Millionaire dancer updated version to beta 0.3.18
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! 
Millionaire Dancer has been updated to beta 0.3.18

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34781823/17fb6e94e3bcf6935ce585c3fde77a733595c683.gif[/img]
[b]The design of the stage and background has been changed.[/b] 

You can see more exciting and dynamic stage.
As the design has changed, the note has been modified to look better.

[b]Three songs are added.[/b]

The track is actually based on the dancer's dancing. I have done a lot of research to bring dance to the game. You can enjoy more fun songs and tracks.

Thank you!

notes.title: Millionaire Dancer updated to version beta 0.0.13.1
notes.notes:
[b]Add Features:[/b]
Feature: Fails when you make a lot of misses during play.
Feature: No failed option.
Feature: Show preview music to be updated soon.

[b]Changes:[/b]
Change: Vibration intensity reduction.
Change: Increase collider size of note hit.

[b]Musics:[/b]
The music "Stereojazyy" will be updated in May.

Thank you!

notes.title: Beta 0.0.13 version will be updated in May.
notes.notes:
Hello!
Here's what we've improved to make the game more fun.

1. As an early access plan, we will continue to increase the number of songs until release. In this May update, we will add a song 'Stereojazyy'.

2. Added game over function make you feel more difficult. Through this, you will struggle to become a Millionaire dancer.

Thank you!

notes.title: Hotfix beta 0.0.12.3s
notes.notes:
Bug Fix: Oculus touch vibration for MultiNote hit.

Thank you!

notes.title: Millionaire Dancer is now available for early access!
notes.notes:
We are very pleased to launch the Millionaire Dancer.

Current version has all the features you can play and a total of 15 difficulty levels(5 songs and 3 difficulty levels each).

Thank you!
